android-content|Images.summary: A Plenix image on Android is the Compose Image (or AsyncImage from the app’s image loader) in a frame of a fixed ratio from the Plenix aspect-ratio scale: the picture fills the frame (ContentScale.Crop) or shows whole (ContentScale.Fit) on the neutral fill, shows that fill while it loads and the image symbol with “Image not available” when it fails. Corners are square inside a card and the media radius when the picture stands alone. TalkBack reads its content description; a decorative picture has none.

variants.name: Cover (default)
variants.use: Thumbnails and previews in a grid of one ratio.

variants.name: Contain
variants.use: Logos, documents and drawings that must not be cropped.

variants.name: Rounded
variants.use: A picture standing alone in content.

variants.name: Error fallback
variants.compose: the error slot: the image symbol and “Image not available”
variants.views: the loader’s error drawable and a TextView
variants.use: Every remote picture that can fail to load.

anatomy.name: Frame
anatomy.about: The box with its ratio from the aspect-ratio scale; it keeps its size before the picture arrives.

anatomy.name: Picture
anatomy.about: The image, cropped to the frame or shown whole.

anatomy.name: Fallback
anatomy.about: The image symbol and “Image not available” on the neutral fill when the picture fails.

attributes.views: setBackgroundColor(fillNeutral) until the picture is set

attributes.value: Square, or the media radius when rounded (PlenixRadius.radiusMedia4px)
attributes.views: ShapeableImageView shapeAppearance with the media corner

attributes.value: The muted content color in DM Sans (PlenixColors.contentMuted)

compose: Modifier.fillMaxWidth().aspectRatio(4f / 3f) // the aspect-ratio scale (4:3), not a Material value
Image(painter, contentDescription = description, modifier = Modifier.matchParentSize(), contentScale = ContentScale.Crop)
